plan: The optimal bidding strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid truthfully. This is because bidding less than your value risks losing the auction when you could have won and made a profit, and bidding more than your value risks winning the auction when you would have been better off losing. Therefore, I will bid my true value.
